create_image_processor: create an Ernie4_5_VLMoeImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images for the ERNIE 4.5 VL MoE vision-language model
preprocess_images: preprocess a batch of images by resizing, patching, and normalizing them for the ERNIE 4.5 VL MoE model input
smart_resize_image: smart resize image dimensions so they are divisible by the patch size factor while staying within min and max pixel bounds
get_number_of_image_patches: get the number of image patches produced for a given image height and width after smart resizing
build_image_grid_thw: build the image_grid_thw tensor describing grid temporal, height, and width dimensions for each image
